data.title: 迦摩 · 金莲宫殿的粉色花嫁
data.description: 【大奥宇宙宫殿·黄昏】迦摩以成年神性形态穿着黑粉色婚纱坐在金色莲台边，银白长发与金饰被微风托起；她懒洋洋地捧住一束星形花朵，先装作不在乎，随后被镜头看久了而露出不耐烦的红晕。
data.location: celestial lotus palace in the Ooku
data.action: 金色莲台边转动星形捧花装作无聊，被镜头注视后隔纱泛红
data.promptProse: Kama from Fate wears a black-and-rose bridal gown with gold trim, a sheer veil and star-shaped celestial flowers. Her long silver-white hair drifts with the cosmic petals as she sits on the edge of a golden lotus dais in her adult divine form, turning a star-shaped bouquet between jeweled fingers. She pretends the ceremony is boring until the viewer keeps looking, then hides a reluctant blush behind the drifting veil. rose-gold sunset among floating petals.
